thread:
emily: Quick heads-up — GigaQuant reached out asking to list their quantized model family (INT8 / INT4) on our marketplace. They want: (1) hosted endpoint listing, (2) optional downloadable bundle for Dedicated customers, and (3) co-marketing. Meeting set for 9am tomorrow. cc @harry (legal) @nina

harry (legal): Need to confirm exact license text. Common issues: downstream redistribution, commercial-use restrictions, dataset attributions, and any "no-derivatives" clauses that would block us from shipping quantized variants. Ask them for full license + any third-party dependency list.

nina: From infra: hosting endpoints = yes. Download bundles = more complicated. For Dedicated we can provide an S3 signed URL that expires and logs who pulled it — but we need provider permission to hand out raw weights. For Private/on-prem installs we prefer giving a pull token instead of us copying weights into customer VPCs. Also: we'll want provenance metadata and checksums.

jared (marketing): If we do a listing + co-marketing we need a copy sign-off window (72h), approved logo assets, and exact attribution text. Also check whether they require an in-UI badge "Model by GigaQuant" — fine, but need to see brand guidelines.

harry (legal): Also escalate export control question: is the model subject to any ECCN or AI-specific export limits? Customer geography restrictions matter. We'll request a warranty from vendor and classification if available.

ops-bot: Reminder: Calendar invite "GigaQuant marketplace sync" at 9:00 tomorrow created by emily. Agenda attached.

sophie: A few ops checklist items I'll own: manifest with SHA256 for each artifact, model_card.md, tokenizer files, quantization script + seed, regression test artifacts (perf vs fp32), and a tagging scheme for provenance (vendor, upload_ts, quant-mode). Will put cost estimate for storage/egress too.

emily: Vendor asked about "redistribution to resellers" — they want to allow partners to re-distribute quantized derivatives. That's risky. @harry any redline thoughts?

harry (legal): If they allow resellers we need: (a) ability to terminate/ revoke distribution, (b) cap liability, (c) indemnity for misuse, (d) clear attribution requirements. Also require export/sanctions reps. I'll prepare a short addendum proposing: host + serve + redistribute limited to named resellers with revocation clause.

nina: Technically, if reseller gets raw weights and runs them in their own infra, we lose observability and can't apply runtime mitigations. Prefer allowing inference calls (hosted) or signed pulls that expire and log pulls. We should require resellers to use our SDK or runtime to ensure telemetry, but vendor may object.

jared (marketing): For co-marketing — ask vendor for a one-paragraph blurb about joint use-cases and a quote. Also confirm embargo and customer announcement sequencing. We generally ask for a 72-hour review window.

emily: Action items: Harry -> draft narrow addendum around hosting & reseller terms. Nina -> ops checklist + cost. Jared -> comms plan + embargo template. Sophie -> list of required artifacts and checksum format. We'll review in the 9am meeting.

harry (legal): I'll post a draft in this thread 2 hours before the meeting. If GigaQuant insists on broad redistribution rights, escalate to commercial for negotiation.

sophie: One extra ops note: if we keep original FP32 sources for audit/build, storage increases ~3x. If vendor can't provide originals we need deterministic quant scripts to reproduce quantized weights and reproducibility proofs.

emily: Got it. I've requested license + dependency CSV + export classification from GigaQuant. Forward anything they send to this thread. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
